q2_gaps: a season as a time expression ("in the winter") — the structured time terms cover Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus bare day-part symbols, but no season term or season rule is given (only deictic "last spring" / "next summer" constants)

a generic / habitual existential ("There are a lot of fires in the winter" = in winters generally) — the existential section yields one specific witness set, and the recurrence has no licensed marker absent "every" wording
a Time atom on a GROUP of event-denoting nouns — Time is stated to attach to an event witness or an event-denoting noun, not to a group aggregate
notes: GroupOf + CardinalityPhrase "a lot of" is the correct branch, since the phrase counts things rather than setting a proportion strength, and no QuantifierPhrase companion is due. What the parse loses is the habitual reading, which the instruction set gives it no way to express.
